title: Physics Practice Test

questions.text: Which of the following quantities is a vector? A speed B distance C displacement D mass
A cyclist accelerates uniformly from rest to a speed of 10 m/s in 5.0 s. Calculate the acceleration of the cyclist.
A resultant force of 8.0 N acts on a trolley of mass 2.0 kg. Calculate the acceleration of the trolley.
Explain what is meant by power.
A wave has a frequency of 40 Hz and wavelength 2.5 m. Find its speed.

A car travelling at 25 m/s brakes with uniform deceleration and comes to rest in a distance of 50 m. (a) Calculate the deceleration. (b) Calculate the stopping time. (c) Explain why the distance is larger on a wet road.
A ball of mass 0.50 kg is dropped from a height of 5.0 m. Calculate its speed just before hitting the ground.
A 4.0 Ω resistor and a 6.0 Ω resistor are connected in series with a 12 V battery. Calculate the current and the potential difference across each resistor.
A trolley of mass 2.0 kg moving at 3.0 m/s collides with a stationary trolley of mass 1.0 kg and they stick together. Calculate their velocity after the collision.
